purpose: Five-arm physical exploration of single-pass borrowed event delivery: matrix
safety: Guarded private mount/PID/net namespace, before/after stock health and owned-directory cleanup per run
memory: Separate actual registration heap diagnostics; proc RSS/HWM remain diagnostic, not PSS or full peak acceptance.
failure_rule: Stop on collection, correctness, identity, health or cleanup failure; retain raw failed window
analysis: All per-block values and paired medians. New high-resolution own-process CPU fields are separate from old tick+reaped-child fields. Four blocks are exploratory, no formal superiority/equivalence verdict. Do not pool pre-power-loss samples. Five implementations in each block; analyze separately from first-candidate runs, even with identical clients.
hypothesis: Single-pass borrowed pattern traversal eliminates target-vector allocation; existing send_borrowed avoids payload clones unless queued. Preserve exact recipient order, dedup, sender suppression, event round and u16 sequence, monitor-before-delivery, queue caps and owned queued bytes. Lazy arm is the deferred first encoding-only candidate.
retention_rule: Reject correctness failures. Report every adverse latency/CPU/throughput/memory direction against all comparators. If at least three of four paired own-CPU changes are positive with median >1%, or p99 median >5% with three positive pairs against accepted before, require a new independently frozen control recheck before retention. Pilot cannot establish full superiority or equivalence.
build_control: Same actual /tmp/owrt-core-release/ubusd source root, SDK, toolchain, cwd and release flags as before; previous exact-root reconstruction reproduced before bytes.
client_control: Frozen ca1a912 client and dependencies plus only process CPU clocks; same binary on all five arms. Do not pool R95/R96 measurements.
metric_directions: Lower is better except ops_per_s, which is higher-is-better. Registration ops are complete add/remove cycles.
